name: northwind_demo
description: Hand-written evaluation set for the Northwind Analytics synthetic corpus (22 documents). Every answer span is a verbatim substring of data/raw, transcribed from the indexed text rather than written from memory. Question types are chosen to separate the retrievers: 'keyword' questions hinge on rare document reference codes that BM25 matches exactly, 'paraphrased' questions deliberately avoid the vocabulary of the source passage so that only a semantic match can find them, and 'multi_step' questions require evidence from two or more documents. 'unanswerable' questions are plausible but have no support anywhere in the corpus and must be refused.
